resources.string: Keeps payment SMS matching active while you are logged in.
Listening for payment confirmation SMS only. Full inbox is never uploaded.

With your opt-in, GressPay Companion listens for new bKash and Nagad payment SMS only (RECEIVE_SMS). It extracts sender rail, amount, and TxID — never the full message body or your inbox. Data is sent over HTTPS to your GressPay server so pending checkouts can be matched. Unrelated SMS are ignored. Turn off matching anytime or clear the device token to stop uploads. This is not an official bKash/Nagad merchant app.
Disable matching or clear the device token to stop evidence uploads immediately.
